text:
alex: quick dump from today's regional latency sweep across us-east / us-west / eu-west. ran redwood-3-small on A100/H100, int8 quant, edge routing toggled. uploading results to s3. TL;DR: edge->nearest reduces p95 for across-the-board west coast traffic but can hurt eu-west tails when traffic funnels through us-east fallback.

bench-bot: automated summary -> s3://redwood-bench/1766312345/summary.csv :chart_with_upwards_trend:

samir: can you paste the run command? want to reproduce locally.

alex: sure — command we used:```bash
runtest --model redwood-3-small 
        --gpu A100,H100 
        --regions us-east,us-west,eu-west 
        --quant int8 
        --seq-len 128 
        --concurrency 64 
        --routing edge,central 
        --duration 10m 
        --output s3://redwood-bench/1766312345/
```

marta: what was the client distribution shape? uniform or geo-weighted?

alex: geo-weighted to mimic production: 50% us-east, 30% us-west, 20% eu-west. also ran a uniform pass for sanity.

alex: raw p50/p95 (int8, seq=128, concurrency=64) — A100:
```
us-east  p50=40ms  p95=120ms  tp=240 tok/s
us-west  p50=50ms  p95=155ms  tp=210 tok/s
eu-west  p50=65ms  p95=210ms  tp=180 tok/s
```

alex: same run H100 (int8):
```
us-east  p50=32ms  p95=95ms   tp=320 tok/s
us-west  p50=38ms  p95=120ms  tp=280 tok/s
eu-west  p50=52ms  p95=160ms  tp=240 tok/s
```

priya: useful. what's the delta when edge routing is OFF (everything routes to nearest central us-east cluster)?

alex: edge off (A100): eu-west p95 jumps to ~280ms, us-west p95 actually improves slightly (because less cross-region routing variability) to ~145ms. overall p50s rise for remote regions.

samir: kernel variants? flash-attn v2 vs fused kernels? which did you use?

alex: we ran two kernel sweeps — default runtime kernel selection used fused-attn for H100 and flash-attn-v2 fallback on A100. Notable: flash-attn-v2 helped p95 for seq=512; fused-attn best for seq<=128 on H100.

marta: seq len 512 numbers? tails tend to explode there.

alex: seq=512 (A100 int8): eu-west p95 ~560ms, us-west p95 ~420ms, us-east p95 ~330ms. H100 cuts those ~30-40% depending on kernel.

priya: capacity sizing note for SLA p95<200ms in eu-west: on A100 we'd need ~+40% capacity or push H100s in eu-west. with edge routing enabled and local H100s, current load meets SLA.

infra-bot: infra reminder — if we add H100 in eu-west, submit infra ticket with region:eu-west, sku:H100, req:2 nodes. I'll create canary route for testing.

samir: can we rerun with kv-cache warmup and 50% cached prefixes? should improve tail in all regions.

alex: yep scheduling that for tomorrow AM. also adding kernel flag sweep: --kernel fused,flashv2,cublas.

priya: would be good to include error percent and retry counts in next dump (I saw small bump in 5xxs from cross-region retries).

alex: noted. I'll add error metrics and attach updated plots.

marta: thanks — let's sync after the warmup run and decide whether to A/B route H100 in eu-west. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: created issue #bench/1766312345: "regional-latency-sweep + edge-routing impact" and attached raw CSVs.

alex: cool, closing for now — follow-up when new run completes.
